I should go to Kali now.
strings.(화이트 콜 협곡 입구 쪽에서 뾰족한 귀를 지닌 한 여성이 천천히 걸어오: (A woman with pointed ears walks slowly toward him from the entrance to White Col Canyon.)
It has been a long time, Sword Master. How long has it been...?
I believe it's been 145 years, five months, and three days since our last gathering.
Has so much time passed already...?
Kali's traditional liquor left quite an impression on me that day. Invite me again if you have the chance.
strings.엄청나게 독해 아무도 마시지 않던 그 술 말씀이시군요. 아쉽게도 남아있지: You mean the liquor so strong that no one would drink it. Unfortunately, none remains.
Shynic will be surprised to hear a shut-in like you has ventured outside. That girl might run here all the way from Tartaros.
It's been so long since we met. Let's stop needling each other.
Then I'll come straight to the point.
strings.자네도 알고 있겠지? 다프네가 무슨 짓을 했는지…?: You know too, don't you? What Daphne did...?
I began to suspect when you uncovered the hidden truth with the Flame of Truth.
Even so, I believed in her.
strings.저에겐 어머니와 같은 분, 그리고 마녀라고 하셨지만…. 단순히 다른 힘을: She was like a mother to me. And although she called herself a witch... I merely thought she was someone with a different kind of power.
strings.하지만, %s 님이 실바리아 제국 황제의 부탁으로 칼리를 방문하고 나서: But after %s visited Kali at the request of the Silvaria Empire's ruler, I learned the truth.
strings.다프네 님이 저에게 숨긴 게 많았다는 걸요. 그리고 마녀들이 많다는 것도: Lady Daphne had hidden so much from me. And there are many witches.
strings.다프네가 원망스럽긴 하지만, 그 기분을 자네에게 풀고 싶진 않네. 좀 더: I resent Daphne, but I have no wish to take that out on you. Is there anything else you know?
strings.확실한 건 그분과 비슷한 목적을 가진 '마녀'들이 있다는 겁니다. 그리고: What I know for certain is that other witches share similar goals. Some have not shown themselves for a very long time.
Troublesome. Witches... Perhaps they are equal to Champions, or greater.
strings.%s 님도 알고 계실지 모르겠습니다. 그분은 '발푸르기스의 밤'을 알고: %s may know something. The adventurer knows of Walpurgis Night.
strings.일단 바이스가 하려는 일부터 해결해야겠네. 그리고 묻고 싶은게 있어. 메: First, we must deal with whatever Weiss intends. And there's something I want to ask you. Medea...
strings.그래서 자네는 언제 그에게 초인으로서 힘의 흔적을 줄 것인가?: When will you give the adventurer a trace of your power as a Champion?
strings.그리고 언제까지 자신을 부정할 셈인가?: And how long do you intend to deny yourself?
